info.name: Create or act on a transaction

items.docs: Creates a transaction. The `tran_type` field selects the action - `sale` or `auth` initiate a new payment (returning a hosted `redirect_url` for HPP/managed/own-form flows, or authorizing a stored `token`), while `capture`, `void`, `release`, `refund` and `register` act on a prior transaction referenced by `tran_ref`. Invoice and recurring flows reuse the same endpoint with additional fields.
